name: smwpatches-course-clear-coins
title: Course Clear Coins
description:
This simple patch replaces the bonus stars at the course clear and gives you coins instead as seen in e.g. JUMP. In addition, you can disable to display bonus star on the status bar or the 1-up bonus if the time's last two digits are identical to the bonus stars due to the fact that the patch renders bonus stars useless.

The best thing is that you don't need any freespace at all.
